info.title: GoodJob Job Fit Strategy API
info.description: Read-only recruitment search API for the GoodJob recruitment support-strategy GPT. Default scope is midsize/large companies and public-sector recruitment: ALIO, CLEANEYE, corporate recruitment DB, and Work24 public recruitment news limited to large companies, public corporations, public institutions, midsize companies, and foreign companies. General Work24 postings are available only with scope=expanded.

post.summary: Search recruitment data or create a role-market snapshot

keyword.description: Job or recruitment keyword. Related role terms may be separated by spaces, commas, vertical bars, or slashes.

region.description: Preferred recruitment region such as 울산, 부산, 경남, 전국.

scope.description: core is the default and targets midsize/large companies plus public-sector recruitment. expanded additionally includes general Work24 postings, including SMEs. Use expanded only when the user explicitly requests broader/all/SME searches.

source.description: Use all normally. work24 and work24_open mean Work24 public recruitment news (large/public/midsize/foreign). work24_general is the general Work24 feed and should normally be paired with scope=expanded.

matchMode.description: Use role for occupation-focused searches. Qualification/preference-only noise and academic specialty false positives are excluded. Work24 public recruitment news uses the recruitment title as role evidence but its region and detailed eligibility still require official verification.

degraded.description: True when one or more requested data sources still failed after automatic retries.

dataAvailable.description: False when none of the requested data sources could be read. Never interpret an empty result as zero market demand when this is false.

sourceCounts.description: Matched result counts by source. WORK24_OPEN is Work24 public recruitment news; WORK24_GENERAL is general Work24 expanded search.

quality.description: Includes directRoleMatches, relatedRoleMatches, regionRolePairingNeedsCheck, and confirmedRegionRoleMatches.
